hazards.evidence: Worn, unsecured throw rug with fringed edges lying loose in the main walking path across the wood floor.
Shoes/boots and piles of clothes/blankets left on the floor in the walkway, narrowing and obstructing the path for a walker.
Strong direct sunlight through the large window creates bright glare patches and deep shadows on the floor that can visually obscure the rug edge and floor items.
